title: FM27 Mods — Real Names, Logo & Face Packs
description: FM27 mods guide: check logo packs, facepacks, skins and real-name fixes against the supported game build before installing community files.
meta: Updated 30 October 2026. Community mod selection and compatibility checks for the PC/Mac Launch Preview.
body:
Looking for FM27 mods, a logo pack or a facepack? Start by checking which game build the author supports. Football Manager 27 releases on 10 November 2026; the PC/Mac Launch Preview is free from 29 October at 18:00 GMT to 3 November at 18:00 GMT. A file labelled FM26 is not evidence of FM27 compatibility.

FM27 logo packs

Logos are graphics packs, distinct from skins and database edits. Check the pack author’s original download page for FM27 support, the update date and the installation instructions. Do not rename a folder from an older game and assume that the config file or club identifiers will work.

Check what the game already includes first: Sports Interactive confirms official club logos, kits and player photos for the licensed Arkema Première Ligue. A missing badge in Preview is not by itself proof that your graphics pack is broken; the official Preview announcement says some club and player assets still await rights-holder approval.

FM27 facepacks

Before downloading a facepack, check its supported game version, whether it is a full pack or an incremental update, and any config or identifier requirements. Keep the author’s folder structure and instructions. Test a named player after installation before adding another pack.

This guide has not verified a specific FM27 facepack or logo pack in-game. The FM Scout FM26 directory is an older-version reference, not a list of confirmed FM27 downloads.

Real-name fixes, skins and editor data

  • Real-name fixes: follow the author’s supported database build and any requirement to start a new save. Do not substitute an older game’s database files.
  • Skins: interface changes have separate compatibility requirements from graphics. Check the author’s supported FM27 build; see our skins guide.
  • Editor data and custom leagues: check game version, dependencies and new-save requirements before enabling files.
  • Third-party tools: use an author-supported game/save version and back up saves before editing.

Before you install a community pack

  1. Record your game platform and build number, including whether you use Preview or the full release.
  2. Use the original author’s download page and confirm that it names your game version.
  3. Back up saves and any files the pack changes. Follow that pack’s folder and cache instructions; this guide has not verified a universal FM27 install path.
  4. Install one addition at a time, then check a known club badge or player face in-game.
  5. If it fails, remove that addition and restore the backup before testing another. Consult the author’s current instructions rather than combining fixes from several game versions.

Why a logo or facepack may not appear

  • Wrong game/build: compare the pack’s compatibility statement with the version you are running.
  • Incomplete download: an update-only archive may require a base pack.
  • Folder/config mismatch: check the author’s expected structure and config; do not guess a path from an FM26 tutorial.
  • Cache: use the author’s reload instructions if provided; do not assume every skin uses the same controls.

Launch Preview and your save

The official announcement confirms that Preview saves can continue into the paid Preview and full launch. That confirms save continuity, not compatibility of any community mod. Check each pack separately after a game update.
